category_title: Underprepared writers who utilize non-standard technology like cell phones for long-form academic papers
scenario_title: Reluctance to engage in peer-review workshops
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a small group classroom setting to critique three separate drafts of their peers' research papers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please exchange the three separate drafts of your research papers with your small group and begin the peer-review critique.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I always thought that peer review was a big waste of time because only the teacher’s opinion matters anyway.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to read through their drafts and write down what you think.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just going to wait for your feedback. Like I said, only the teacher's opinion matters for my grade.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is important to work with your group. Please share your thoughts with them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing it. It's an everyone-for-him-or-herself culture. When you’re drowning, the last person you think to turn to is someone else who doesn’t know how to swim.

task.content: Participating in critiquing three separate drafts of their peers’ research papers, and receiving extensive critique on their own assignment drafts.
task.learning_goal: To sponsor the learning advantages associated with small groups.

context.environment: One of nine classrooms hosting a peer-review workshop group.
context.materials: Three separate drafts of peers' research papers.
context.social_setting: Small groups assigned to classrooms for reciprocal peer-review.
context.time_context: Throughout the duration of the writing program.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Initial reluctance to seek help from peers who are also struggling.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Stated, “When you’re drowning, the last person you think to turn to is someone else who doesn’t know how to swim.”
related_quotes: When you’re drowning, the last person you think to turn to is someone else who doesn’t know how to swim.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Expressed that they “always thought that peer review was a big waste of time because only the teacher’s opinion matters anyway”.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Belief that peer feedback is valueless compared to instructor feedback.
